description: This Java class defines a command handler for updating withholding tax on savings accounts in the Apache Fineract project. It implements processing logic by calling the relevant service method, and is annotated for Spring dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: UpdateWithHoldTaxSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing 'UPDATEWITHHOLDTAX' commands on savings accounts, delegating the actual update to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update withholding tax on a savings account by invoking the service method.
